document.name: CampusSphere Enterprise User Seed Dataset
document.purpose: Initial realistic college identity dataset for authentication, RBAC, WGate, audit, and academic-scope testing
document.passwordWarning: demo123 is development-only. Never use it for production accounts.

userGenerationRules.management: 1 initial management user per department; responsibility metadata covers Years 1-4 and Semesters 1-8
userGenerationRules.hod: 1 HOD per department with access to all department years/semesters/courses
userGenerationRules.faculty: 20 per department; default 5 faculty per Year of Study
userGenerationRules.students: 30 per department per Year of Study
userGenerationRules.studentBatchRule: Year 1=2026-2030, Year 2=2025-2029, Year 3=2024-2028, Year 4=2023-2027 for the initial 2026-27 academic context
userGenerationRules.facultyCourseRule: Do not infer final course editing permission from defaultYear; create explicit FacultyAssignment records
userGenerationRules.enrollmentRule: Do not create final course enrollments in the user seed; generate them from curriculum/course offerings

requiredChecks: Exactly eight HOD users, one per department
Exactly twenty FACULTY users per department
Exactly five default FACULTY users per Year of Study per department
Exactly thirty STUDENT users per Year of Study per department
Every FACULTY user has a department
Every HOD user has a department
Every STUDENT user has department, batch, yearOfStudy and currentSemester
